description:
Engwe Ease 2 Pro is a 4-wheel electric scooter with seat for adults. It is portable and safe, and is an excellent mobility solution for adults, including the elderly.
Parameters of Engwe Ease 2 Pro Adult Scooter
1. Weight: 43.2lb lightweight body, easy to operate and transport.
2. Material: Made of aluminum alloy, it is not only light but also durable. The body is foldable and easy to carry.
3. Battery: 2 24V 10Ah long-life lithium batteries, which can support long-life and reliable performance.
4. Motor: 270W brushless motor, which will not make extra noise, making travel more comfortable.
5. Headlight: Bright LED headlight, which can maintain visibility even at night to ensure your safety.
Highlights of Engwe Ease 2 Pro Foldable Mobility Scooter
1. Easy to carry
As a folding electric scooter, Engwe Ease 2 Pro can be simply folded and placed in the trunk, home and other small spaces. At the same time, it is lightweight and can be easily taken on the train, which is very convenient.
2. Excellent endurance
Equipped with 2 high-quality 24V 10Ah lithium batteries, the Engwe Ease 2 Pro electric scooter bike has excellent endurance, which can eliminate your mileage anxiety.
3. Intelligent climbing assistance
Engwe Ease 2 Pro electric mobility scooter can help riders conquer 12° slopes. Not only that, the assistance it provides is also very intelligent, automatically slowing down when going downhill and automatically increasing assistance when going uphill.
4. Different usage modes
Ease 2 Pro has two modes to choose from: self-driving and freewheel mode. You can adjust it according to your needs.

With the portable electric scooter Engwe Ease 2 Pro, you can enjoy great convenience whether at home or on the go.
